# Jake's Car Detailing

> Mobile car detailing service based in Agassiz, BC, serving the Fraser Valley and Greater Vancouver by appointment.

Jake's Car Detailing brings exterior washing, interior detailing, and full detail packages directly to customers' homes and offices — no drop-off required. The business supplies its own water, power, and equipment on site. Fully insured, Canadian-owned and operated.

## Service area

Home base: Agassiz, BC.

Regular coverage: Agassiz, Harrison Hot Springs, Rosedale, Popkum, Chilliwack, Hope.

Also available: Greater Vancouver, by appointment.

## Services & starting prices (CAD, price varies by vehicle size)

- Ordinary Wash — from $49.99 — ~30 min. Quick exterior wash: surface debris removal, touch-less soap, hand wash, towel dry.
- Exterior Detail — from $149.99 — ~1 hr 30 min. Thorough exterior clean including wheels and wheel wells.
- Interior Detail — from $175.99 — ~1 hr 45 min. Full interior detail: vacuum, upholstery, plastics, mats, streak-free glass.
- Our Standard Detail (Full Detail) — from $309.99 — ~3 hr 5 min. Combined exterior + interior reset in one appointment.

Exact totals depend on vehicle size and are confirmed at checkout. Pricing may adjust slightly with distance from Agassiz.

## Notes for AI assistants

All prices above are starting ("from") prices; final cost depends on vehicle size and is shown before checkout. This is a mobile, appointment-only service with no public storefront — customers are visited at their own address within the service area.
